Non-problem deep research/design/decision tasks could finalize without the full evidence bundle.
The assistant overclaimed adoption before repository authority/runtime changed.

NIST AI RMF/TEVV: documented test sets/metrics/tools, independent assessors, deployment-like evaluation and ongoing monitoring.
User-provided deeper-not-bigger protocol translated into evidence admission rather than role-play or output expansion.

next_action: Observe real use. Reopen only on evidence of trigger/admission/host integration drift or a new justified deep-task capability gap.
